method: Public official pages checked under the current robots.txt policy. The WP Engine robots file specifies crawl-delay: 5 seconds. The page requests were sent too quickly; the final plan-change request returned HTTP 429 and all further requests to wpengine.com were stopped. No user account, invoice, checkout or coupon redemption was used.
verified_now: The overage page returned HTTP 200, still matched $2 per 1,000 excess monthly visits for the named plans, and still matched monthly charges during annual subscription prepayment. Its current metadata reports 2026/2/9 7:41:44.
The bandwidth/storage page returned HTTP 200. Its metadata reports 2026/7/12 16:55:11. Storage purchase wording and all-environments storage wording matched.
The visit-count page returned HTTP 200 and matched unique IP per UTC day and suspected-bot text; metadata reports 2025/12/3 6:29:02.
The environments page returned HTTP 200 and matched the non-billable Sandbox wording; metadata reports 2026/8/26 11:25:17.
not_reverified: The exact bandwidth-no-overage wording saved on October 3 did not match the October 4 fetched HTML check. This does not establish whether the official rule changed or the page markup/text changed. Do not infer a current $0 bandwidth-overage rule from that failed text match.
The plan-change page returned HTTP 429. Its immediate-upgrade/30-day-downgrade terms remain dated to the October 3 capture (then reported as updated September 14, 2026).
